hero.eyebrow: For garment factories and sewing plants · iPad, Android and Web
hero.h1: Your garment production, under control. Even when the internet drops.
hero.lead: Trama connects cut orders, plants and shipments in a single board. Assign work by capacity, track every garment from the cutting table to the warehouse, and spot what's urgent before it becomes a problem.
hero.img_alt: Trama dashboard with revenue in production, plant capacity and cutting table status

origin: Born on the production floor of Industrial Peña Balles, a multi-plant garment manufacturer in Mexico: years of real cut orders, plants and deliveries turned into a tool any factory can use.

what.h2: Garment manufacturing software, built for the tablet.
what.body: Trama is production control software for apparel factories and contract manufacturers. It records cut orders (list, garment, style, customer, quantity and price), assigns them to your plants based on monthly capacity, tracks each cut through cutting, sewing, pressing, packing, warehouse and shipping, and flags urgent deliveries. The iPad and Android app works offline; the web version brings Trama to any office computer.

product.h2: Your whole factory flow, from order to shipment.
product.lead: Designed for tablets: quick to use one-handed on the shop floor, with every detail available in the office.

cap.h: Split every cut order across your plants without exceeding capacity.
cap.p: Each plant has a monthly capacity. When you assign work, Trama shows live how much of that month each cut takes up in every plant: whether it fits, whether it overflows and which plant has the most room.

board.h: Drag each cut order to its status.
board.p: Waiting, on the cutting table, ready to sew. A visual board your cutting manager updates with a finger.

reports.h: Every garment, from table to warehouse.
reports.p: Plant, cutting and shipping reports feed a funnel for each cut: cut, sewn, pressed, packed, in warehouse and shipped.

Daily target, estimated days and months, price per minute and net income as you type.

licensing.h2: Not a download. Set up for your company.
licensing.lead: Trama's apps aren't in the public app stores. Each company gets a private licence, a managed installation on its devices and real, hands-on support.

steps.p: Pick a plan or tell us how many plants and users you have.
We show you Trama with data that looks like your factory's.
Published pricing and everything in writing, no hidden costs.
Apps: private distribution to your iPads and Android devices, no public download. Web plan: sign in with a username and password.
Data migration, role-based training and ongoing support, depending on your plan.

items.a: Web is $49 per month, Plant $99, Multi-plant $249 and Enterprise starts at $590, plus taxes. Pay yearly and you get 2 months free. Pricing is per company, not per user.

items.q: What's the difference between the app and the web version?
items.a: The iPad and Android app keeps your data on the device, so it works offline, it's faster and it uses the camera for style photos. The web version needs no installation and runs on any computer, but it requires a connection. Plant, Multi-plant and Enterprise include both.

items.q: Can I download Trama from the App Store or Google Play?
items.a: No. The apps are distributed privately to licensed companies, so you control which devices have them and nobody outside your company can install them. The web version is accessed with a username and password.

items.q: Do I need internet to use it?
items.a: Not with the app: sign-in, cut orders, reports, catalogs and charts all work offline, and everything syncs when the connection comes back. The web version does need a connection.
Yes. There's a native app for Android 8.0+ tablets and phones, with the same rules and the same backup format as the iPad app.
With the app, in a local database on each device, with automatic backup. You can also export full backups at any time and restore them on another iPad or Android device.

items.q: Can you migrate data from my current system?
items.a: Yes. Migration is included in Multi-plant and Enterprise: we import plants, customers, suppliers, styles, cut orders and reports. We review your case during the demo.

It's a system to plan and track apparel production: which cut orders exist, which plant is making them, how far along each one is and when it ships. Trama does it on a tablet, offline, with a role for each manager.

items.q: Does it work for contract manufacturers?
items.a: Yes. Trama was born at a multi-plant contract manufacturer: it assigns cut orders based on each plant's monthly capacity, logs daily production and prioritizes urgent shipments by the customer's delivery date.
